name: luideag

attributes.attribute: a monstrous female lake spirit of Scottish lore

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The luideag is a female being of Scottish folklore. She haunted a lake on the Isle of Skye. She had a plain form and a quick temper. People kept away from the water because of her. She belongs to the larger body of Scottish water lore.

okr.objective: Describe the luideag of Scottish water lore.
key_results: Name the luideag as a monstrous female lake spirit of Scotland
Put her home on the Isle of Skye
Note her great ugliness and short temper
